column1: # Cost corrections for system dictionary words: reading, surface, and an
# offset added to the cost of every entry with them (higher is rarer). Each
# row must match an entry. Add a row when a common word loses to a rarer one
# of the same reading, with a test sentence in eval/everyday.tsv.
# 他に案ある: the bean paste あん (4845) was cheaper than 案 (4957).
# 給料日 is a common noun and should stay intact after a date expression.
# 歌詞 should win over 化+し for standalone かし.
# Favor the colloquial adjective デカく and the temporal compound 補正後.
# Established terms that split into more common short homophones.
# SudachiDict words get a flat cost, so a popular title loses to 地位+側.
# The place name should stay intact instead of splitting into た + 強羅.
